name: Natsuiro Yakou
source:
"I want to... be here..." 

My cousin Tsuya Mikage was waiting for me when I got home. We first met six months ago at my aunt's funeral.

These were extenuating circumstances, and if it was just one night...

I let him stay.

But that night, from the witching hour, our bodies came together...

"I want to be here. I'm... exposed? I'm trapped in my family."

Summer was just beginning. The season was still a bit wet and dreary.

A strange life of shared housing began with a young boy whose heart was in a dark place.

translation:
“我想……在这里……” 

当我回到家时，表弟御影津也正在等我。我们第一次见面是六个月前，在我姨妈的葬礼上。

这些都是情有可原的情况，如果只是一个晚上……

我让他留下来。

但那天晚上，从巫术时刻开始，我们的身体聚集在一起……

“我想来这里。我……暴露了？我被困在我的家庭里。”

夏天才刚刚开始。这个季节仍然有点潮湿和沉闷。

一个内心阴暗的小男孩开始了奇怪的合租生活。
